text: Not every break needs to be the same. So why do wellbeing apps treat you like it does?
I've got two minutes, and my hands are aching.
Serein asks first. Find a pause that fits.
What's happening around this pause? Between tasks. How much time do you have? Two minutes. What would feel comfortable?
Three suggestions, each with a clear reason. Breathing Tide. Hand and Finger Reset. Here and Now.
Ninety seconds for tired hands. Settle. Rest your forearms. Then gently uncurl your fingers, only as far as feels easy.
Stop or adapt whenever you need to. Nothing here is a score.
